title.en: Flower Shop Orders and Preparation Assistant

vacancy_label: Synthetic vacancy; not a real opening

requirements.en: Receive and label flower stock against approved supplier and shop records.
requirements.zh: 依据经批准的供应商记录和门店记录，接收花材库存并贴标签。

requirements.en: Prepare orders from existing recipes and verify supplied message-card text.
requirements.zh: 按现有配方准备订单，并核对提供的留言卡文字。

requirements.en: Maintain collection records and communicate pending orders and materials.
requirements.zh: 维护取货记录，并沟通待处理订单及物料情况。

requirements.en: Preferred: independently design and deliver commissioned wedding arrangements.
requirements.zh: 优先：独立设计并交付受委托婚礼花艺。
